digest.component_or_area: fallback model orchestration and class configuration
propositions: Direct Anthropic fallback arms for frontier and standard classes are not currently active in rebar.toml because fallback configuration entries are missing

Configuring fallback chains causes capability intersection to silently downgrade both primary and fallback from native to prompted structured output, affecting all calls in that class regardless of which model is invoked
Direct Anthropic Sonnet has been live-proven to support native structured output and thinking, resolving the prior asymmetry and enabling capability-symmetric fallback for the standard class

The whole-chain capability intersection mechanism is intentional by design but prevents fallback enablement without a capability regression; per-attempt resolution would decouple primary capability from fallback fallback constraints
Frontier and standard model classes should be configured in rebar.toml with matching direct-Anthropic fallback arms, while trivial remains single-arm pending direct-Haiku parity measurement
